variants.about_this_item: Beaphar Long Coat Shampoo for Dogs is a gentle, pH neutral shampoo speically formulated for dogs with longer fur that needs extra care during grooming. The mild formula cleanses without stripping away the natural oils, helping keep the coat comfortable and looking healthy. Its anti-tangle shampoo action supports easier brushing after washing, helping reduce knots and tangles so the coat feels smoother and more manageable. Enriched with Almond oil and Aloe vera, this detangling shampoo for dogs helps leave fur soft, glossy and freshly cleaned from root to tip. It’s the ideal shampoo for long-haired dogs after muddy walks, or as part of a regular routine to keep long fur looking neat. If you’re searching for the best dog shampoo for long coats, this formula is designed to help maintain shine and improve comb-through. Beaphar Long Coat Shampoo for Dogs is made with 0% parabens and silicones, and the bottle is recyclable and made from 50% sustainable recycled PET.
variants.ingredient_information: Composition: Aqua, sodium laureth sulfate, peg-200 hydrogenated glyceryl palmate, glycereth-2 cocoate, cocamidopropyl betaine, peg-7 glyceryl cocoate, sodium chloride, polysorbate 20, glycereth-7 caprylate/caprate, parfum, lauryl lactate, hexyl cinnamal, disodium edta, prunus amygdalus dulcis oil, glycol distearate, sodium c14-16 olefin sulfonate, polyquaternium-7, citric acid, glycine, benzyl alcohol, triethylene glycol, geraniol, aloe barbadensis leaf extract, propylene glycol, sodium benzoate, sorbitan laurate, phenoxyethanol, sodium citrate, methylchloroisothiazolinone, methylisothiazolinone, magnesium chloride, magnesium nitrate, potassium sorbate, ci 17200.
variants.feeding_instructions: Wet the coat with warm water, massage in gently until it lathers, then rinse thoroughly. Repeat as required and dry well afterwards
